Checker role for Finance-governed functions. Never holds maker/initiation authority for the same governed action.

Operational administration (customer/aggregator/support-workforce administration, observability). No financial mutation authority, no agent-network lifecycle ownership.
Owns agent network lifecycle and agent fund/defund initiation (maker side only; FINANCE_CONTROLLER approves per Decision 7).
KYC and non-FRAUD compliance case/risk-profile administration.
FRAUD-category compliance case authority only. No AML/SANCTIONS case authority.
Customer viewing/history/support-case authority. No customer lifecycle mutation, no financial mutation.
Decision 6: holds exactly reconciliation.view and nothing else in V1. No external settlement/suspense functionality exists yet.

Delegated day-to-day workforce administration, not a second SUPER_ADMIN.
